idea: Grocery Price Inflation Google Trends Spike Signals Consumer Staples Demand

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'grocery prices' and 'food inflation'

behavior: When consumers search for grocery price information more intensely, it signals heightened awareness of food cost pressure and willingness to trade down or shift purchasing patterns.

market_impact.rationale: Staples companies benefit from flight-to-safety during inflation anxiety; discount retailers outperform premium brands.

trade_logic.entry: When Google Trends search volume for 'grocery prices' exceeds 70th percentile of 52-week rolling history, enter long XLP
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or when search volume falls below 50th percentile

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Grocery price discussions spike weekly during inflationary periods and seasonal food cost transitions; Google Trends data is real-time and fires multiple times per month.

idea: Airline Fuel Surcharge News Spike Signals Travel Sector Headwind

data.source: RSS news feed count for airline fuel surcharge announcements and price hikes

behavior: When airlines announce fuel surcharges or price hikes, it signals rising operational costs and margin compression; news spike precedes booking decline.

market_impact.rationale: Airlines and travel discretionary companies face reduced demand and lower margins when fuel costs are flagged publicly.

trade_logic.entry: When daily RSS count for 'airline fuel surcharge' or 'airline price hike' exceeds 5 articles and is above 90th percentile of 60-day rolling history, enter short XLY
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 6 trading days or when daily RSS count falls below 3 articles for 2 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Airlines regularly announce fuel adjustments and pricing changes; news spike frequency is 1–2 times per week during volatile oil periods.

idea: Job Listing Velocity Deceleration FRED Labor Data Signals Hiring Cooldown

data.source: FRED series: Total Nonfarm Payroll (PAYEMS) and Job Openings (JTTS) weekly/monthly changes

behavior: When job opening counts decline sharply relative to payroll growth, it signals slowing demand for new hires and rising recession risk; precedes earnings miss.

market_impact.rationale: Hiring slowdown foreshadows consumer discretionary weakness as unemployment risk rises and wage growth cools.

trade_logic.entry: When JTTS falls more than 3% week-over-week and is below its 52-week moving average, enter short XLY
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 7 trading days or when JTTS rebounds above prior week level

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: FRED labor data is released weekly; job opening drops of 3%+ occur several times per quarter in normal market cycles.

idea: Container Port Backlog RSS Surge Signals Industrial Demand Weakness

data.source: RSS news feed count for 'port congestion', 'container backlog', and 'shipping delay' announcements

behavior: When news about port congestion and container backlogs spike, it signals reduced import velocity and weak industrial demand; counterintuitive to old supply-chain headlines.

market_impact.rationale: Port backlog reduction signals lower demand for goods and industrial equipment; negative for industrial cyclicals.

trade_logic.entry: When daily RSS article count for 'container backlog' or 'port congestion' exceeds 4 articles and is above 85th percentile of 30-day rolling history, enter short XLI
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 5 trading days or when article count falls below 2 for 2 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Port and logistics news spikes 2–4 times per week during seasonal demand swings and geopolitical disruptions.

idea: Cybersecurity Budget Squeeze Google Trends Signals Tech Services Headwind

data.source: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'enterprise cybersecurity cost' and 'IT security budget'

behavior: When searches for enterprise cybersecurity budget and cost concerns spike, it signals CIO cost pressure and deferred IT spending; negative for tech services vendors.

market_impact.rationale: Tech services and software companies face reduced enterprise spending when IT budgets come under pressure.

trade_logic.entry: When Google Trends search volume for 'cybersecurity budget' or 'IT security cost' exceeds 75th percentile of 52-week rolling history, enter short XLK
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 6 trading days or when search volume falls below 55th percentile

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Budget constraint discussions spike quarterly during earnings season and fiscal planning windows; 2–3 triggers per quarter expected.

idea: EV Charger Rollout Deceleration Signals Green Energy Capex Pullback

data.source: OpenChargeMap API weekly charger count increments across North America

behavior: When weekly growth in public EV charger installations declines sharply, it signals slowing green energy infrastructure investment and policy support; precedes energy transition slowdown.

market_impact.rationale: EV charger slowdown signals reduced government green energy policy execution and capital deployment; negative for renewable transition thesis.

trade_logic.entry: When weekly charger count growth rate falls below 0.5% and is below 52-week moving average of growth rate, enter short XLE
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or when growth rate rebounds above 1%

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Charger deployment fluctuates with funding cycles and policy changes; growth rate dips occur 1–2 times per quarter.

idea: Weather Extreme Heat Spike Google Trends Signals Utility Demand Surge

data.source: Open-Meteo API daily maximum temperature combined with Google Trends searches for 'air conditioning repair' and 'cooling center'

behavior: When daily maximum temperatures exceed historical highs for the date AND Google Trends search interest for AC repair spikes, it signals peak utility demand and grid stress.

market_impact.rationale: Extreme heat drives peak electricity demand, higher wholesale prices, and margin expansion for utilities.

trade_logic.entry: When daily max temperature exceeds 92°F AND Google Trends 'air conditioning repair' volume exceeds 75th percentile of 30-day history, enter long XLU
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 5 trading days or when temperatures fall below 85°F for 2 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Heat waves and AC repair search spikes occur multiple times during summer months; daily trigger potential is high.

idea: Earthquake Activity Regional Insurance Cost Spike Signals XLV Hospital Demand

data.source: USGS Earthquake Activity API daily magnitude ≥4.0 events combined with RSS news for 'earthquake insurance cost'

behavior: When seismic activity spikes in populated regions and insurance-related news follows, it signals increased hospital demand and healthcare capex; precedes injury and treatment volume surge.

market_impact.rationale: Earthquake aftermath drives emergency room visits, orthopedic procedures, and mental health services; bullish for healthcare providers.

trade_logic.entry: When USGS reports ≥2 magnitude-4+ earthquakes in North America within 7 days AND 'earthquake insurance' RSS count exceeds 3 articles, enter long XLV
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 6 trading days or when magnitude-4+ event frequency returns to baseline

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Regional earthquake clusters occur several times per quarter; news follow-through is reliable when magnitude >4.0.

idea: Bank Mortgage Rate Lock Surge RSS Signals Housing Sector Rotation

data.source: RSS news feed count for 'mortgage rate lock', 'rate buydown', and 'financing incentive' announcements

behavior: When news about mortgage financing incentives and rate locks spike, it signals builder/lender desperation to move inventory; precedes housing demand weakness.

market_impact.rationale: Aggressive financing promotion by builders signals slowing demand and potential price correction in residential real estate sector.

trade_logic.entry: When daily RSS article count for 'mortgage rate lock' or 'rate buydown' exceeds 3 articles and is above 80th percentile of 30-day rolling history, enter short XLRE
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 7 trading days or when article count falls below 1 for 3 consecutive days

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Builder financing promotions are announced weekly during seasonal demand windows; RSS spike frequency is 1–3 times per week.

idea: Retail Same-Store Sales Deceleration FRED Signals Consumer Discretionary Slowdown

data.source: FRED series: Retail Sales (RSXFS) and Retail Trade Employment (RETA) weekly/monthly changes

behavior: When retail sales growth decelerates sharply relative to prior 4 weeks and falls below prior-year growth, it signals consumer discretionary weakness and inventory correction.

market_impact.rationale: Retail sales slowdown precedes earnings misses and margin compression in discretionary retailers and restaurants.

trade_logic.entry: When RSXFS monthly change drops below 1% AND is below prior month by >0.5 percentage points, enter short XLY
trade_logic.exit: Exit after 8 trading days or when monthly change exceeds 1.5% for 2 consecutive weeks

reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: FRED retail data is released monthly; deceleration triggers occur 2–4 times per year during normal market cycles.
